hooks.command: echo "[彼方希冀] 文件已修改，请及时 Review。"
INPUT=$(cat 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '"command"\s*:\s*"git commit'; then bash .claude/hooks/git-commit-validate.sh <<< "$INPUT"; fi
INPUT=$(cat 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '"command"\s*:\s*"git push'; then bash .claude/hooks/git-push-validate.sh <<< "$INPUT"; fi
